To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
bronze filled PTFE composite material can be used as journal bearing material in Sugar mill.
the wear rate and friction coefficient of bronze filled PTFE composite are lower than that of PTFE.
the wear rate of PTFTE composites filled with 10% bronze particles is less than that of PTFE filled with 20% bronze particles.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the tribological investigation of bronze filled PTFE composite materials for journal bearing application.
the tribological behavior of PTFTE composites.
the friction and wear behavior investigation of PTFE composite filled with bronze particles as a bearing material for sugar mill application.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the wear and frictional behavior of the composite is greatly influenced by load.
the wear resistance of PTFE bronze composites is significantly improved by the addition of bronze particles.
the wear rate and the frictional force of the PTFE compositing filled with bronze particles is lower than the PTFE alone.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the wear rate of PTFe composite is very less and friction is also less compared to the existing gun metal bearings.
the friction and wear behavior is studied by varying loads of sugar mills.
the wear rate of PTFe 40 bronze filled composites increases with increase in load and the wear rate decreases with increase in sliding distance.

the friction and wear behavior can be improved with the increase in bronze particle content in the PTFE compositing materials.
